def within_user_percentile(users, scores):
    """Convert scores to within-user percentile ranks (0..1) for cross-family blend."""
    users = np.asarray(users)
    scores = np.asarray(scores, dtype=np.float64)
    out = np.empty(len(scores), dtype=np.float64)
    order = np.argsort(users, kind="stable")
    su = users[order]
    starts = np.searchsorted(su, np.unique(su), side="left")
    ends = np.append(starts[1:], len(users))
    for s, e in zip(starts, ends):
        idx = order[s:e]
        sc = scores[idx]
        r = sc.argsort(kind="stable").argsort(kind="stable").astype(np.float64)
        out[idx] = r / max(len(sc) - 1, 1)
    return out
